    The 2024 Nobel Prizes were awarded by the Nobel Foundation, based in Sweden. Six categories were awarded: Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences. The winners in each category were announced from October 7 to October 14.

    The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton on October 8, 2024, in Stockholm, Sweden. They were recognized for their foundational work in machine learning using artificial neural networks.

    The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics has been awarded to John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton for their groundbreaking contributions that have significantly advanced the field of artificial intelligence (AI).
